propositions: fsck --output json issue_count is recomputed as len(issues) counting every KIND line, while the exit code is derived from is_issue-respecting tally, causing divergence on never-counted kinds
never-counted kinds (push_pending, status_fork_resolved, tracker_dirty_tmp_event, warn) inflate JSON issue_count without affecting exit code
an uninitialized store renders as clean in JSON output (empty issues, issue_count=0) byte-identically to a healthy store despite returning exit code 1
issue_count must be redefined to the counted subset matching is_issue=True findings so it agrees with exit code across all three surfaces (CLI, fsck_report library, MCP FsckOut)
each issues[] item requires an additive counted boolean to distinguish counted from never-counted findings while preserving complete findings list
_NEVER_COUNTED_KINDS constant must be single-sourced and derived from _DIRTY_LINE_SPECS (lowercased) plus explicit scan kinds to prevent drift when new is_issue=False kinds are added
